verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud Frontend Observability automatically captures errors from real users (grafana-docs-41), and the Knowledge Graph surfaces error and failure insights (grafana-docs-59), so application errors are collected. Nothing in the pack shows those errors grouped into issues, displayed with stack traces, tied to releases, or flagged as regressions; the only adjacent item is database-focused 'analyze deployment impact' (grafana-docs-58). Missing for 10: error grouping into issues, stack trace views, release tracking, regression detection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
